Maya: Fortnightly pulse — token usage: -12% WoW, +8% QoQ. 7-day avg throughput ~1.2k rps, peak 3.8k. 95p latency up from ~180ms -> ~260ms on text-gen route. Error rate (5xx) 0.9% (was 0.3%). Spend pacing +22% vs committed. Notable: Brightline caused two burst windows Wed 11:30-12:15 UTC.
Jon: Got it. Can we get per-route breakdown and top API keys? pinging @Liam for telemetry export.
Liam: grabbing now. Quick FYI: default aggregation window = 5m. Will paste the query I'm running.
Liam: ```sql
SELECT route, sum(tokens) AS tokens, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p95, sum(case when status >= 500 then 1 else 0 end) as errors
FROM telemetry.transactions
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens desc
LIMIT 10;
```
Liam: Top three routes: /v1/chat (48% tokens), /v1/generate (22%), /v1/embed (10%). Most errors concentrated on /v1/chat (error rate ~1.5% during the spike) and correlated with p95 jumps. Window: Wed 11:45-12:30 UTC.
Ana: that aligns with Brightline's maintenance window — they re-ran a heavy transform job. I already pinged their infra lead; they say it's a one-off but want guidance. I recommended client-side retries and shorter prompt pre-caching.
Maya: Renewal flag: Brightline moved to YELLOW — two overage alerts in the past 14 days. CS next steps: billing review + tuning session. @Jon please own scheduling.
Jon: On it. I'll set up a 30-min tech + billing sync next week and share the tuning playbook + cost breakdown. Who should be on the attendee list?
Maya: include Brightline eng lead, their billing contact, Ana, and Liam.
Maya: Ops question — any infra events that could explain p95 spike besides client burst? @OpsBot any pod evictions or GPU OOMs around Wed 11:30?
OpsBot: [automated] Cluster alert summary for 1769504321 window: no node reboots. 2x pod restarts on cluster-3a between 11:40 and 11:55 due to OOMKilled on model-worker-12 (image a1b2c3). Network latency within thresholds.
Liam: Pod restarts line up with p95 spikes. Suggest applying short-lived prefix caching + tighten rate-limit for that API key to smooth bursts. Also recommend adjusting batching window to 40ms during peak.
Ana: I'll draft the rate-limit rule (burst allowance 1200 r/s -> sustained 400 r/s with a 10s token bucket) and propose a short cache TTL for repeated prefixes. Also advising Brightline to move heavy batch job outside peak.
Ana: If they want sustained throughput, bumping their dedicated pool 2->3 GPUs during their KPI window is the straightforward option; cost delta estimate attached in the ticket.
Maya: Action items: Jon -> schedule tuning + billing sync (due Mon). Ana -> implement rate-limit + send pool recommendation to Brightline (due Tue). Liam -> publish dashboard panels and the event window details (due today EOD). Ops -> increase alert sensitivity for OOMKilled on model-worker-* and keep an eye on cluster-3a.
Jon: ack. I'll create the calendar invite and share agenda.
